citations.title: A Stereoscopic Look into the Bulk
Equivalence of Emergent de Sitter Spaces from Conformal Field Theory

claims.statement: In the cited AdS3/CFT2 construction, an oriented boundary interval or boundary-anchored geodesic can label one point of kinematic space.
claims.scope: the specified holographic construction and its endpoint parameterization

claims.statement: OPE blocks can be organized as fields on kinematic space and related at leading semiclassical order to bulk geodesic or minimal-surface integrals.
claims.scope: the source's CFT and semiclassical holographic hypotheses

claims.statement: Emergent de Sitter kinematic descriptions have been compared across vacuum, thermal, and nontrivial three-dimensional gravity states with state-dependent qualifications.
claims.scope: the cases analyzed by the source rather than every quantum state

limitations: The packet does not claim that arbitrary intervals in arbitrary systems form a smooth kinematic manifold.
Geodesic multiplicity, quotient identifications, and phase transitions can require branch data beyond endpoint labels.
Calling an interval a point in kinematic space does not remove its extension in the original space.
